parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four rotation lids of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a flap that can be folded to close or open the box, protecting the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box body, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the cardboard box, made of the same material as the others.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in sealing the box when folded inward, contributing to the overall closure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line at the top edge of the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as a cover flap that folds over the box opening to secure the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its fold line, moving up and down to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It completes the closure system of the box, overlapping with other lids when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line, folding inward or outward.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the box, forming the base and sides, made of corrugated cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds the contents of the box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports the rotation lids.
